title: feat(AT-598): Payments, Secondary, Groupping skills
creator: ItayRafe
summaryParagraphs: This PR adds three domain skills: grouping, payments, and secondary. The grouping skill includes references for API surface, architecture, backend and frontend consumers, Prisma and type domain models, and federation. The secondary skill includes architecture, domain model, lifecycle, permissions, and security-group references.

The payments skill is the largest single file in the PR, while grouping and secondary are broken into smaller reference documents. The entire PR is markdown documentation and appears intended to make domain-specific agent work more reliable across these areas.
